title: Seetha's insistence on going to the forest
introduction: Seetha implores upon Rama to allow her to come to forests, and says that she heard through some foretellers that she has to live in forests for some time, when she was with her father's place. But Rama is not interested to make Seetha's life penurious in forests and once again tries to pacify her. He asks her to stay back at Ayodhya. For that Seetha laments to become lonely parted with her husband.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अयोध्य काण्डे एकोन त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus completes 29th chapter of Ayodhya Kanda in glorious Ramayana, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुह्खिता |
प्रसक्त अश्रु मुखी मन्दम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
etat tu vacanam śrutvā sītā rāmasya duhkhitā |
prasakta aśru mukhī mandam idam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Seetha was distressed to hear these words of Rama and spoke these words slowly, with her face with tears.

glosses.meaning: having the face wet with tears

verses.devanagari:
ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यताम् प्रति |
गुणान् इति एव तान् विद्धि तव स्नेह पुरः कृतान्
verses.iast:
ye tvayā kīrtitā doṣā vane vastavyatām prati |
guṇān iti eva tān viddhi tava sneha puraḥ kṛtān
verses.translation: "know all those disadvantages you mentioned about dwelling in the forest become advantages to me, if your affection is placed before them."

glosses.meaning: if your affection is placed before them.

verses.devanagari:
मृगाः सिम्हा गजाश्चैव शार्दूलाः शरभास्तथा |
पक्षिणः सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः
अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव |
रूपम् दृष्ट्वापसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति
verses.iast:
mṛgāḥ simhā gajāścaiva śārdūlāḥ śarabhāstathā |
pakśiṇaḥ sṛmarāścaiva ye cānye vanacāriṇaḥ
adṛśhṭapūrvarūpatvātsarve te tava rāghava |
rūpam dṛśhṭvāpasarpeyurbhaye sarve hi bibhyati
verses.translation: "Oh Rama! Antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas(legendary animal with eight legs), birds, yaks and all others which roam in the forest, run away after seeing your form, since they have never seen your figure before. When there is cause for fear, who would not have fear?"

glosses.meaning: sarabhas(a legendary animal with eight legs and said to be more powerful than the lion)
since they have never seen your figure
when there is cause for fear

verses.devanagari:
त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया |
त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम्
verses.iast:
tvayā ca saha gantavyam mayā guru jana āGYayā |
tvad viyogena me rāma tyaktavyam iha jīvitam
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! As per the command of the elders, I also should go along with you. My life is to be abandoned here, if I were separated from you."

glosses.meaning: as per the command of the elders

verses.devanagari:
न च माम् त्वत् समीपस्थम् अपि शक्नोति राघव |
सुराणाम् ईश्वरः शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुम् ओजसा
verses.iast:
na ca mām tvat samīpastham api śaknoti rāghava |
surāṇām īśvaraḥ śakraḥ pradharṣayitum ojasā
verses.translation: "Oh Rama! Even Devendra the Lord of celestials, by his strength, cannot over power me, who is in your vicinity."

verses.devanagari:
पति हीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम् |
कामम् एवम् विधम् राम त्वया मम विदर्शितम्
verses.iast:
pati hīnā tu yā nārī na sā śakṣyati jīvitum |
kāmam evam vidham rāma tvayā mama vidarśitam
verses.translation: "Oh Rama! Verily such a thing was taught to me by you, that a woman disunited from her husband should not be able to survive."

verses.devanagari:
अथ च अपि महा प्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानाम् मया श्रुतम् |
पुरा पितृ गृहे सत्यम् वस्तव्यम् किल मे वने
verses.iast:
atha ca api mahā prāGYa brāhmaṇānām mayā śrutam |
purā pitṛ gṛhe satyam vastavyam kila me vane
verses.translation: "Oh Rama, the very wise! Besides, formerly in my father's house it was heard by me from the month of brahmanas that I was destined to stay really in a forest."

glosses.itrans: the very wide man! atha chaapi
glosses.iast: the very vide man! atha cāpi
glosses.devanagari: थे वेर्य् विदे मन्! अथ चापि

verses.devanagari:
लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे |
वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल
verses.iast:
lakṣaṇibhyo dvijātibhyaḥ śrutvā aham vacanam gṛhe |
vana vāsa kṛta utsāhā nityam eva mahā bala
verses.translation: "Oh Rama the man of great strength! Ever since I heard this word from brahmanas who can interpret marks on the body, I was always eager to stay in a forest."

glosses.meaning: who can interpret marks on the boday
I was enthusiastic to live in a forest.

verses.devanagari:
आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल |
सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा
verses.iast:
ādeśo vana vāsasya prāptavyaḥ sa mayā kila |
sā tvayā saha tatra aham yāsyāmi priya na anyathā
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama the beloved! That prediction of dwelling in the forst is to be realised by me. I must accordingly accompany you to the forest, it cannot be otherwise."

glosses.meaning: of dwelling in the forst praaptavyaH kila = is to be realised by me

verses.devanagari:
कृत आदेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया |
कालः च अयम् समुत्पन्नः सत्य वाग् भवतु द्विजः
verses.iast:
kṛta ādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi saha tvayā |
kālaḥ ca ayam samutpannaḥ satya vāg bhavatu dvijaḥ
verses.translation: "I shall be the one who has fulfilled the brahmana's word. I shall accompany you to the forest. The time has come for brahmana's words to come true."

glosses.meaning: the one who has fulfilled brahmana's word

verses.devanagari:
वन वासे हि जानामि दुह्खानि बहुधा किल |
प्राप्यन्ते नियतम् वीर पुरुषैः अकृत आत्मभिः
verses.iast:
vana vāse hi jānāmi duhkhāni bahudhā kila |
prāpyante niyatam vīra puruṣaiḥ akṛta ātmabhiḥ
verses.translation: "Oh valiant prince! I know that in the forest, sufferings indeed are many and are invariably obtained by men having unformed minds."

verses.devanagari:
कन्यया च पितुर् गेहे वन वासः श्रुतः मया
भिक्षिण्याः साधु वृत्ताया मम मातुर् इह अग्रतः
verses.iast:
kanyayā ca pitur gehe vana vāsaḥ śrutaḥ mayā
bhikṣiṇyāḥ sādhu vṛttāyā mama mātur iha agrataḥ
verses.translation: "While I was an unmarried girl, the prediction about my dwelling the forest was heard by me in my father's house from a female mendicant having good manners, in the presence of my mother."

verses.devanagari:
प्रसादितः च वै पूर्वम् त्वम् वै बहु विधम् प्रभो |
गमनम् वन वासस्य कान्क्षितम् हि सह त्वया
verses.iast:
prasāditaḥ ca vai pūrvam tvam vai bahu vidham prabho |
gamanam vana vāsasya kānkṣitam hi saha tvayā
verses.translation: "Oh Lord! In the past, you have been really pleased for many a time to take me along with you indeed for the tour of a forest, as longed by me."

glosses.meaning: for many a time vanavaasasya gamanam = for the tour of a forest

verses.devanagari:
कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव |
वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते
verses.iast:
kṛta kṣaṇā aham bhadram te gamanam prati rāghava |
vana vāsasya śūrasya caryā hi mama rocate
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! May all be well with you! I am waiting for a journey to the forest. A work-out of adventurist is really delightful to me."

glosses.meaning: with you! aham = I kR^itakshhaNaa = am waiting
is really delightful mama = to me.

verses.devanagari:
शुद्ध आत्मन् प्रेम भावाद्द् हि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा |
भर्तारम् अनुगच्चन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम्
verses.iast:
śuddha ātman prema bhāvādd hi bhaviṣyāmi vikalmaṣā |
bhartāram anugaccantī bhartā hi mama daivatam
verses.translation: "Oh, the pure-minded! Following my husband with loving devotion, I shall become sin-less; for husband is the supreme deity to me."

glosses.devanagari: थे पुरे मिन्देद्! प्रेम भावात् हि

verses.devanagari:
प्रेत्य भावे अपि कल्याणः सम्गमः मे सह त्वया |
श्रुतिर् हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानाम् यशस्विनाम्
इह लोके च पितृभिर् या स्त्री यस्य महा मते |
अद्भिर् दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्य भावे अपि तस्य सा
verses.iast:
pretya bhāve api kalyāṇaḥ samgamaḥ me saha tvayā |
śrutir hi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānām yaśasvinām
iha loke ca pitṛbhir yā strī yasya mahā mate |
adbhir dattā svadharmeṇa pretya bhāve api tasya sā
verses.translation: "Even after my death, I shall stay united with you. On this subject, the meritorious words of brahmanas is being heard thus:- In this world, which woman was given away to whom by parents with water according to the moral code binding on them, that woman belongs to him alone even after death.

glosses.meaning: she(belongs) pretya bhaave.api = even after death.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् अस्मात् स्वकाम् नारीम् सुवृत्ताम् हि पति व्रताम् |
न अभिरोचयसे नेतुम् त्वम् माम् केन इह हेतुना
verses.iast:
evam asmāt svakām nārīm suvṛttām hi pati vratām |
na abhirocayase netum tvam mām kena iha hetunā
verses.translation: "By what reason now are you thus not willing to take me, the woman having good conduct, devoted to her husband and belonging to you, from this place?"

verses.devanagari:
भक्ताम् पति व्रताम् दीनाम् माम् समाम् सुख दुह्खयोह् |
नेतुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुख दुह्खिनीम्
verses.iast:
bhaktām pati vratām dīnām mām samām sukha duhkhayoh |
netum arhasi kākutstha samāna sukha duhkhinīm
verses.translation: "Oh Rama, the seion of Kakutsa! You ought to take me, who is a devotee, so devoted to husband, who is distressed who feels alike in pleasure and pain and shares your joys and sorrows."

glosses.meaning: sharing in your joys and sorrows.

verses.devanagari:
यदि माम् दुह्खिताम् एवम् वनम् नेतुम् न च इच्चसि |
विषम् अग्निम् जलम् वा अहम् आस्थास्ये मृत्यु कारणात्
verses.iast:
yadi mām duhkhitām evam vanam netum na ca iccasi |
viṣam agnim jalam vā aham āsthāsye mṛtyu kāraṇāt
verses.translation: "I shall take resort to poison or fire or water for dying, if you are not willing to take me, afflicted as I am, as above."

verses.devanagari:
एवम् बहु विधम् तम् सा याचते गमनम् प्रति |
न अनुमेने महा बाहुस् ताम् नेतुम् विजनम् वनम्
verses.iast:
evam bahu vidham tam sā yācate gamanam prati |
na anumene mahā bāhus tām netum vijanam vanam
verses.translation: Eventhough she requested him in many ways about setting out to the forest, he did not agree to take her to the forest, which is a solitary place.

glosses.meaning: about setting out(to the forst) mahaabaahuH = Rama

verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता |
स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः
verses.iast:
evam uktā tu sā cintām maithilī samupāgatā |
snāpayantī iva gām uṣṇaiḥ aśrubhir nayana cyutaiḥ
verses.translation: After hearing Rama's words, seetha was sorrowful, moistening with earth as it were with burning tears, trickling down her eyes.

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तयन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु निवर्तयितुम् आत्मवान् |
ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीताम् काकुत्स्थो बह्व् असान्त्वयत्
verses.iast:
cintayantīm tathā tām tu nivartayitum ātmavān |
tāmrośhṭhīṃ sa tadā sītām kākutstho bahv asāntvayat
verses.translation: Rama the prudent man then pacified in many ways, to avert that Seetha with red lips, who was sorrowful as above.
